display.name: Retail Starter
display.description:
A low-minimum entry point built for small allocations. Ticket sizes start near the protocol deposit minimum so a depositor can participate without committing meaningful capital, and the manager still posts a first-loss buffer well above total depositor principal.

Conservative carry-only strategy with a high 1.80x exit threshold and unrestricted per-depositor withdrawal limits: small depositors can always get their full balance out in a single window, which matters more at this ticket size than squeezing out incremental yield. Intended as the on-ramp product.
display._x_note: X linking needs a real OAuth click-through per vault (getXChallenge -> authorize on X -> setVaultXConnection). Not automatable; see README.
